# gitlab_personal_access_token (Ephemeral Resource)

The `gitlab_personal_access_token` ephemeral resource creates a personal access token that is never persisted to the Terraform plan or state.

-> This ephemeral resource requires administration privileges and Terraform 1.10 or later.

~> A new token is created every time the ephemeral resource is opened, which happens during both `terraform plan` and `terraform apply`. When `revoke_on_close` is `false`, each run leaves an active token behind until it expires, so always set `expires_at` in that case.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/user_tokens/#create-a-personal-access-token-for-a-user)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Short-lived token that is revoked at the end of the Terraform run
ephemeral "gitlab_personal_access_token" "example" {
  user_id    = 25
  name       = "Example personal access token"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31"
  scopes     = ["api"]
}

# Use the token to configure another provider without storing it in state
provider "gitlab" {
  alias = "as_user"
  token = ephemeral.gitlab_personal_access_token.example.token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the personal access token.
- `scopes` (Set of String) The scopes of the personal access token. valid values are: `api`, `read_user`, `read_api`, `read_repository`, `write_repository`, `read_registry`, `write_registry`, `read_virtual_registry`, `write_virtual_registry`, `sudo`, `admin_mode`, `create_runner`, `manage_runner`, `ai_features`, `k8s_proxy`, `self_rotate`, `read_service_ping`
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the personal access token.
- `expires_at` (String) When the token will expire, YYYY-MM-DD format. When not set, GitLab applies the instance default lifetime.
- `revoke_on_close` (Boolean) Whether to revoke the token when Terraform closes the ephemeral resource at the end of the run. Set to `false` when the token must outlive the run, for example when it's passed to a write-only argument of another resource. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) True if the token is active.
- `created_at` (String) Time the token has been created, RFC3339 format.
- `revoked` (Boolean) True if the token is revoked.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token of the personal access token.
- `token_id` (Number) The ID of the personal access token.
